shared_elements: large elaborate headdress or head covering occupying the top of the field
low-relief ornament applied over the body
circular disc/medallion motif on the torso
horizontal band across the waist/belt region
figure filling a tall vertical monolithic field
justification: Both depict a single upright anthropomorphic figure occupying a tall field, crowned by a broad headdress and bearing relief ornament on the torso, including a circular disc motif and a horizontal belt-like band, which is a fairly specific shared scheme of figure-plus-regalia. However, A is a densely carved, curvilinear composition with a profusion of ornament, held objects and rectangular glyph-like blocks, whereas B is a massive, blocky, near-blank body carrying only a few sparse shallow motifs and no accompanying signs or attributes, so the manner of depiction and the density of iconography differ greatly.
